note: Ten sources for the GTA VI trophy list and guides. Link status was checked live (HTTP HEAD, browser User-Agent) on 2026-11-21. LIVE LINK means the page returned HTTP 200 and is linked; TEXT ONLY means the page returned HTTP 403 and is named without a link.

sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.role: Trophy guide & roadmap — difficulty 4/10, ~200 hours, the one possibly missable trophy, 100% checklist details, chapter saves, cheats rule.

sources.name: Exophase
sources.role: Official trophy list as shown on PlayStation Network (names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags), cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.role: Official trophy list as shown on PlayStation Network (names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags), cross-checked with Exophase and TrueAchievements.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6
sources.role: Full 55-trophy list split into 27 visible and 28 hidden, with grades and Gamerscore, cross-checked with Exophase, PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements.

sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.role: Complete 55-trophy list with grades and descriptions, split into non-hidden and hidden (spoiler) sections.

sources.name: GameMapa
sources.role: Full 55-trophy list with Gamerscore, platinum roadmap in three steps, the one possibly missable trophy, and per-trophy tips (stunts, Gunslinger, five unsolved hidden trophies).

sources.name: EGamers
sources.role: Full 55-trophy list with grade split (27 visible / 28 hidden), hardest trophy, and the one possibly missable trophy.

sources.name: CryptoGames
sources.role: Full 55-trophy list with grade split, hardest trophy, and the one possibly missable trophy.

sources.name: GTASpotter
sources.role: Full official trophy list with platinum roadmap (difficulty, time, missable, cheats, 80 challenges, 100% checklist) and spoiler-free / spoiler sections.

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.role: Trophy guide & platinum roadmap — story steps, 100% checklist details (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 15 card sets, 33 underwater discoveries), and the balcony meditation warning.
